question_text: A civil servant took a personal loan of P120,000 at 8% simple interest. Total to repay after 2 years?

hint_ladder.title: Orient
hint_ladder.text: Simple interest problem: hanapin total na babayaran – principal plus total interest sa loob ng 2 taon. Hindi compounding, sa principal lang nagana ...

hint_ladder.title: Rule
hint_ladder.text: Interest = Principal × Rate × Time. Gawaing decimal ang rate (8% → 0.08) at siguraduhing nasa taon ang time. I-multiply nang sunod-sunod.

hint_ladder.title: Apply
hint_ladder.text: Unahin ang 1 taon: P120,000 × 0.08 = P9,600. Ito ang interest kada taon. Para sa 2 taon, i-multiply sa 2: P9,600 × 2 = P19,200 total interest.

hint_ladder.title: Nearly There
hint_ladder.text: Total repayment = principal + total interest. I-add mo ang P19,200 sa P120,000. Anong sagot? Isipin mong parang nagdagdag ka lang ng tubo sa inutang.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you calculated only 1-year interest (P9,600) instead of 2 years.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you used 1.5 years instead of 2, giving P14,400 interest.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you used 20% total interest instead of 16% (8%×2).

next_time_rule: Simple interest formula: P×R×T. Compute annual interest (P120k×8%=P9,600), multiply by 2 years, add to principal. Check time period!
deconstruct_text:
Alam mo, imagine nangyari kay Aling Nena, civil servant sa City Hall. Nag-loan siya ng P120,000 sa cooperative para sa sari-sari store, at 8% simple interest per year, payable in 2 years. Para malaman ang total, i-compute muna ang isang taong interest: P120,000 × 0.0...

Dahil 2 taon ang loan, multiply mo ulit: P9,600 × 2 = P19,200. So total interest is P19,200. Pagkatapos, i-add mo sa principal: P120,000 + P19,200 = P139,200.

Mental Trick (Taglish): Isipin mong 'Una, isang taon; tapos, times years'—parang pagbibilang ng jeepney fare kada pasahero, iniiscale mo sa bilang ng sakay. Kaya iwasan ang shortcut na 1 year lang; kumpletuhin ang term.
